body.text: The NHV is allocated per building. It provides fresh air and controls exhaust from all NI buildings.
body.anchor: is allocated on a per building basis within the nuclear island

body.text: The RAB, RXB, FHB, and FAB have RCAs, where airflow goes from lesser to higher potential contamination.
body.anchor: HVAC airflow is controlled from areas of lesser potential contamination to areas of higher potential contamination

body.text: The NCB does not contain RCAs.
body.anchor: The Nuclear Island Control Building (NCB) does not contain RCAs

body.text: The NHV is NSRST to support radionuclide retention and MCR isolation.
body.anchor: to support radionuclide retentions functions described in Section 7.5.1.2

body.text: The controlled combined release path from the FHB, RXB, RAB, and FAB through the monitored plant stack is an NSRST function.
body.anchor: through the monitored plant stack is an NSRST function

checks.q: Which way does RCA airflow go?
o: Straight to the stack with no filter
checks.x: Airflow goes from areas of lesser to areas of higher potential contamination.
checks.anchor: HVAC airflow is controlled from areas of lesser potential contamination to areas of higher potential contamination

checks.x: The NCB does not contain RCAs.
checks.anchor: The Nuclear Island Control Building (NCB) does not contain RCAs

body.text: RXB HVAC keeps the building at slightly negative pressure with NST HEPA exhaust units. Exhaust goes to the monitored stack.
body.anchor: The RXB HVAC equipment maintains the building at slightly negative pressure

body.text: HAA isolation uses one inboard and one outboard air operated valve pair for each penetration.
body.anchor: the double isolation arrangement of one inboard and one outboard air operated valve pair

body.text: The below grade SCG vapor trap cell is slightly negative with an inerted atmosphere and is monitored for SCG leakage.
body.anchor: The below grade SCG vapor trap cell is maintained at slightly negative pressure with inerted atmosphere

body.text: The reactor overpressure protection release point is the SCG trap cell.
body.anchor: The reactor overpressure protection release point is the SCG trap cell

body.text: The trap cell is automatically isolated on leakage indication in the MCR.
body.anchor: The SCG trap cell is automatically isolated upon leakage indication in the MCR

body.text: The NHV cooling loop isolates automatically on reactor vessel relief valve position.
body.anchor: The cooling loop is automatically isolated based on the position indication of the reactor vessel relief valves

checks.q: What is the release point for reactor overpressure protection?
checks.x: The reactor overpressure protection release point is the SCG trap cell.
checks.anchor: The reactor overpressure protection release point is the SCG trap cell

checks.q: How is each HAA penetration isolated?
o: An inboard and an outboard valve
checks.x: There is one inboard and one outboard air operated valve pair for each penetration.
checks.anchor: the double isolation arrangement of one inboard and one outboard air operated valve pair

body.text: RAB HVAC also keeps the building slightly negative, using NST HEPA exhaust units to the monitored stack.
body.anchor: The RAB HVAC equipment maintains the building at slightly negative pressure

body.text: Below grade SPS cells are slightly negative with inerted atmosphere during operations.
body.anchor: Below grade SPS cells are maintained at slightly negative pressure with inerted atmosphere

body.text: SPS cell leak detectors connect to an NFP sodium leak detection control panel. It sends signals to the utility monitoring and control system for cell isolation.
body.anchor: transmits the sodium leak detection signals to the nuclear island utility monitoring and control system

checks.q: How is SPS cell isolation signaled?
o: From the NACP through the utility monitoring and control system
checks.x: The NACP transmits leak signals to the utility monitoring and control system.
checks.anchor: transmits the sodium leak detection signals to the nuclear island utility monitoring and control system

body.text: FHB normal exhaust goes through two 50 percent HEPA filtration units.
body.anchor: The FHB normal exhaust is provided through two 50 percent HEPA filtration units

body.text: Differential pressure monitors on the main working floor control exhaust flow to keep the FHB slightly negative.
body.anchor: Exhaust flow is controlled by differential pressure monitors installed on the main FHB working floor

body.text: All FHB exhaust goes through welded ductwork, HEPA filters, and the monitored stack.
body.anchor: through welded ductwork, HEPA filters and out the monitored plant stack

body.text: High radiation on HEPA filter discharge alarms in the MCR for manual operator action.
body.anchor: Indication of high radiation on the HEPA filter discharge alarms in the M

checks.q: How many FHB exhaust filter units does normal exhaust use?
checks.x: Normal exhaust is through two 50 percent HEPA filtration units.
checks.anchor: The FHB normal exhaust is provided through two 50 percent HEPA filtration units

body.text: Sodium monitors, toxic chemical sensors, and a radiation monitor continually sample the MCR fresh air intake.
body.anchor: Sodium monitors, toxic chemical sensors, and a radiation monitor continually sample the MCR fresh air intake

body.text: On an elevated hazard, an MCR alarm alerts operators to place MCR HVAC units in recirculation and deenergize the below grade HVAC systems.
body.anchor: to place the MCR HVAC units in recirculation mode and deenergize the below grade HVAC systems

body.text: Deenergizing below grade HVAC prevents similar hazards in the remote shutdown facility.
body.anchor: to prevent similar hazards in the remote shutdown facility

body.text: Recirculation credits NSRST HEPA filters to minimize operator dose.
body.anchor: Recirculation mode of the MCR HVAC credits the NSRST high efficiency particulate air

body.text: If MCR personnel evacuate to the RSC, a manually operated compressed breathable air bottle rack supports post accident monitoring.
body.anchor: a manually operated compressed breathable air bottle rack

checks.q: The MCR intake sodium monitor alarms. What does the PSAR say operators do?
o: Place MCR HVAC in recirculation and deenergize below grade HVAC
checks.x: The alarm alerts operators to place units in recirculation and deenergize below grade HVAC.
checks.anchor: to place the MCR HVAC units in recirculation mode and deenergize the below grade HVAC systems

checks.q: What provides a habitable environment for monitoring in the RSC?
checks.x: NHV provides a manually operated compressed breathable air bottle rack.
checks.anchor: a manually operated compressed breathable air bottle rack

title: Nuclear Island HVAC System
subject: NHV
intro: The NHV is planned building by building. Its safety-significant work is isolating penetrations, filtering exhaust, and keeping the control room habitable.
